derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of G4632 (σκεῦος);
def: properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset

occurrences.text: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
